source_text: VI. Passus est autem beatissimus Cyprianus martyr die octava decima kalendarum Octobrium sub Valeriano et Gallieno imperatoribus, regnante vero domino nostro Iesu Christo; cui est honor et gloria in saecula saeculorum, amen.
pass_a_gloss: But the most blessed Cyprian as martyr suffered on the eighteenth day before the Kalends of October under Valerian and Gallienus as emperors, with our Lord Jesus Christ truly reigning; to whom is honor and glory unto ages of ages, amen.
pass_b_english: But the most blessed martyr Cyprian suffered on the eighteenth day before the Kalends of October, under the emperors Valerian and Gallienus, while our Lord Jesus Christ reigns, to whom are honor and glory for ever and ever.

lemmas.gloss: on the day, ablative of time
Kalends, first day of the month

choices.english: on the eighteenth day before the Kalends of October
choices.why: ablative of time with Roman inclusive backward reckoning from the Kalends; kept as ancient formula rather than converting to a modern calendar date

choices.term: regnante vero domino nostro Iesu Christo
choices.english: while our Lord Jesus Christ reigns
choices.why: ablative absolute with vero marking contrast between the earthly emperors named under sub and the present reign of Christ
rejected: in the reign of our Lord Jesus Christ
